projects.description: Nx projects to migrate. Defaults to every project in the workspace. Use this to adopt v3 one app or library at a time instead of rewriting the whole monorepo in one run - but keep a query client and the creators built from it in the same run, since they are migrated together.

include.description: Path prefixes to migrate, relative to the workspace root (e.g. 'libs/queries'). Unioned with `projects`. Defaults to the whole workspace.
